ModMetaData.name: Test Harness — P1 Namespaced Def
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: Exercises the P1 node-id keying fix live. Ships a C# assembly defining a custom def subclass `JoofTest.PropDef : Def`, declared in XML by its FULLY-QUALIFIED element name (<JoofTest.PropDef>). The XML element name ("JoofTest.PropDef") differs from the type's simple name ("PropDef"), which is exactly the divergence P1 fixes: RegisterNode must key the node by the element name (like every consumer) so a change to the def is dirtiable. The harness swaps the def's field value between Run A and Run B; with the fix the changed def is dirtied under "JoofTest.PropDef/TC_P1_Prop" and the gate stays a superset, with the old keying it was filed under "PropDef/TC_P1_Prop" and silently missed. No game content — dev/QA use only.
